VENDORED CHESS LIBRARIES - do not edit these files
==============================================================================

The Puzzle of the Day board on the home page is drawn by two open-source
libraries. They used to be downloaded from the jsDelivr CDN on every visit;
they now sit here, in the site, so the puzzle still works if that CDN is
blocked, slow or down. Nothing on the site talks to jsDelivr any more.

    chessground 9.2.1    assets/vendor/chessground.js
                         assets/vendor/chessground.base.css
                         assets/vendor/chessground.brown.css
                         assets/vendor/chessground.cburnett.css
                         Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later
                         Source:  https://github.com/lichess-org/chessground

    chess.js 1.4.0       assets/vendor/chess.js
                         Licence: BSD-2-Clause
                         Source:  https://github.com/jhlywa/chess.js

The two .js files are the unmodified browser bundles jsDelivr builds from
those packages (single files, no imports). The only change made here is that
the trailing "//# sourceMappingURL=" comment was removed, so a browser with
devtools open does not try to fetch a map from jsDelivr.

USED BY
    assets/puzzle.js         imports ./vendor/chessground.js and ./vendor/chess.js
    assets/puzzle-loader.js  adds the three chessground stylesheets

TO UPDATE
    1. Fetch the newer bundle and stylesheets for the version you want, e.g.
         https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chessground@9.2.2/+esm
         https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chessground@9.2.2/assets/chessground.base.css
         (and .brown.css and .cburnett.css)
         https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chess.js@1.5.0/+esm
    2. Replace the files here, keeping the same names.
    3. Remove the sourceMappingURL comment line again if it is present.
    4. Update the version numbers in this file and in the comment at the top of
       assets/puzzle.js.
    5. Test the puzzle on the home page: the board should appear, a wrong move
       should be marked, and the hint and solution buttons should work.

These files are committed on purpose. They are not build output and they are
not regenerated by anything in scripts/.
